title: Agent Delegation Audit Event
description: One decision in an agent delegation chain. Hash-chained, tamper-evident, offline-verifiable. Published as an open standard so SIEMs and observability tools can ingest agent-authority decisions in a common format.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; gaps are provable evidence of deletion.

ts.description: Trusted timestamp (RFC 3339 string) or monotonic integer in tests.

event.description: root=chain start; spawn=delegation minted; allow/deny=action authorization; kill=cascade revocation; done=node lifecycle end (holder finished; informational).

task.description: Natural-language task the delegation was scoped to.

reason.description: Denial reason: scope | egress | max_rows | max_spend | max_depth | max_fanout | chain_ceiling | chain_revoked.

revoked.description: Node ids revoked by a kill.
